title: Why Nvidia's real moat isn't the chip

beats.text: Everyone thinks Nvidia wins on chips. That's wrong.
AMD, Google and Amazon all build fast AI chips.
Yet Nvidia still earns roughly 90% of its revenue from data centers.
The reason is software. In 2006, Nvidia announced CUDA.
Today, 6 million developers build on it.
Switching chips means rewriting years of code.
The moat isn't the chip. It's the code.

sources: NVIDIA Q4 & FY2026 results: revenue $215.9B, Data Center $193.7B
